==Units==
'''XR''' may refer to these units:
*[[Armored XR600]], a unit that used to be spawned by the Level 2 [[Mecha Base]]
*[[XR600]], a unit that used to be spawned by the Level 0 and 1 [[Mecha Base]]
*[[XR700]], a unit that used to be spawned by the Level 3 [[Mecha Base]]
*[[XR900]], a unit that used to be spawned by the Level 4 [[Mecha Base]]
*[[XR901]], a unit that used to be spawned by the Level 5 [[Mecha Base]]
